title: Mounting and Disposal Allowance on Out-of-Area Replacements
content:
Under Road Hazard Protection, the mounting and disposal shown on an outside shop's receipt for an out-of-area tire replacement are reimbursed according to what the plan includes on a Crestline replacement. The allowance figures are the per-tire charges of the covered set's tire line.

**Out-of-area service allowance.** On a plan that includes both mounting and balancing and the valve stem and disposal on a replacement, the receipt's mounting and disposal are reimbursed at the tire line's mount-and-balance charge per tire plus its tire disposal fee per tire; on a plan that includes mounting and balancing but not the valve stem and disposal, the mounting is reimbursed at the mount-and-balance charge per tire; on a plan that includes neither, no service allowance is paid.

The allowance is added to the out-of-area reimbursement.

| Plan | Mounting included | Valve stem and disposal included | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection | yes | yes | mount-and-balance charge plus disposal fee |
| Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection | yes | yes | mount-and-balance charge plus disposal fee |
| Crestline Road Hazard 36-Month Protection | yes | no | mount-and-balance charge |
| Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection | yes | no | mount-and-balance charge |
| Crestline Road Hazard 24-Month Protection | no | no | none |
| Crestline Road Hazard 12-Month Protection | no | no | none |

*Hypothetical figures.* A line with a 20.00 mount-and-balance charge and a 4.00 disposal fee: 24.00 on the first two plans, 20.00 on the next two, nothing on the last two.
